basic_profile.bio: Avid anime enthusiast based in San Francisco, with a particular passion for 'Attack on Titan'. By day, I work as a software developer, bringing my love for storytelling into the world of game design. I'm an active participant in online anime discussions, often exploring fan theories and character arcs. Outside of work and anime, I enjoy hiking and exploring the vibrant local culinary scene. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, especially during weekdays, and often catch up with threads while commuting. Currently in a long-term relationship.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive knowledge in anime series, particularly 'Attack on Titan', gained through years of dedicated watching and discussing with fellow fans. I also have a background in computer science, which enhances my understanding of narrative structures and character development, both self-taught and through formal education.
